title: Contribution proposals
description: Reviewable proposals for how participant contributions might change an LTP model. Never a merge: the target ltp-model.yaml is not modified by anything in this file.

title.description: Shown in the demo header, e.g. 'Demo C — the room's contributions'.

model_source.description: Repo-relative path of the LTP model these proposals were made against, e.g. ltp/ltp-model.yaml.

model_sha256.description: Set by build-demo.py. Records which version of the model was on screen.

contributions_source.description: Where the raw contributions came from — file name, form, or doc.

attribution.description: How contributors are credited on screen. Default to numbered unless the room consented to names.

contributor.description: As it should appear on screen — 'Participant 7', a first name, or a full name if consent was given.

text.description: The contribution VERBATIM. Never tidied, corrected, shortened by rewording, or stitched together from separate passages. Shortening is allowed only by taking a shorter continuous run.

statement.description: The reader's one-sentence reading of the claim, in model register. This is the machine's words, and the interface labels it as such.

note.description: Anything the reading had to assume, drop, or guess at.

entity.description: Required for add_entity. The node that would be created.

placement.description: Where in the model the proposal lands. Which fields are required depends on the operation — see build-demo.py, which enforces it.

view.description: A key of the model's views map — the tree the room will be looking at.

connects_to.description: Existing entity id. The parent for add_entity; the subject for support_entity and challenge_entity.

relation.description: Link relation for add_entity and add_link, e.g. necessary_for, causes, enables, contributes_to.

rationale.description: Why this address and not another, in terms a person can check against the tree in front of them.

alternatives.description: Other addresses considered. Recorded for honesty; the interface shows one recommended proposal, not a menu.

status.description: Always pending on disk. Accept/reject happens live in the browser and is never written back.
